properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 3DES reaches this build through two providers: the vendored crypto-js bundle inside the shipped web3.min.js (dApp frontend) and pycryptodome declared in requirements.txt. Additionally a live-executed 3DES-CFB demo with a hard-coded key exists in lectures/intro_cripto.ipynb — a location the deterministic pass never reached; reported as a separate finding. The cipher itself is Sweet32-vulnerable and NIST-deprecated regardless of quantum concerns.

Third-party dev-tool chain, not the dApp application; no application call site. Dependency inventory for the vendored lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live MD5 (hashlib.md5) in a submitted homework solution. Related but separate: the repo also ships a full from-scratch MD5 implementation (assignments/Solutions/md5.py, reported as its own finding). MD5 is collision-broken — the rating-D defect that must not queue behind post-quantum work.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js's CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.random implementation bundled inside truffle-contract.js: a Math.random()-seeded mzc/mwc-style generator re-mixed with Math.random on every draw; the two sites are the two draws inside one function. This is the weak non-CSPRNG a crypto library uses to produce "random" bytes (crypto-js salt generation). Present in the shipped bundle; no direct app call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
